about.title: About us
about.text: "Afrikanischen in Dortmund e.V." is a registered non-profit association founded jointly by Senegalese residents of Dortmund. The focus of our work is personal counselling, support and guidance for migrants and refugees from Sub-Saharan Africa as they manage their everyday lives, as well as promoting solidarity and coexistence among people from different cultures.

about.p1: "Afrikanischen in Dortmund e.V." is a registered non-profit association founded jointly by Senegalese residents of Dortmund.
about.p2: The focus of our work is personal counselling, support and guidance for migrants and refugees from Sub-Saharan Africa as they manage their everyday lives, promoting solidarity and coexistence among people from different cultures, and promoting family and parent work.
about.p3: In addition, we promote human rights and equal opportunities for disadvantaged groups, as well as development cooperation and international relations between Germany and Senegal.
